::: {.script}
What to know before you go
:::

::: {.pine-divider}
:::

```{=html}
<details class="faq-item">
<summary>Is there a ceremony?</summary>
<div class="faq-answer"><p>No ceremony is planned. We were married in a private ceremony on 07.10.26, and we can't wait to celebrate our union with everyone at the lodge!</p></div>
</details>

<details class="faq-item">
<summary>What should I wear and pack?</summary>
<div class="faq-answer"><p>For Friday, think sundresses, khakis or jeans, and short-sleeve summery polos. Saturday is a laid-back field day, so wear whatever's comfortable and easy to move in.</p><p>We'll be on the grass both days, so shoes that won't sink into the ground work best. Flats, wedges, block heels, boots, and sneakers are all great choices. Northern Arizona evenings get chilly even when the day is warm, so bring layers and a warm jacket.</p></div>
</details>

<details class="faq-item">
<summary>Can we swim in the pond?</summary>
<div class="faq-answer"><p>Yes! There's a rope swing, and you're welcome to hop in. Towels, pool noodles and water guns are provided, just pack a swimsuit. The pond is gated and fenced, and we ask that any kiddos in the water have a grown-up keeping watch.</p></div>
</details>

<details class="faq-item">
<summary>Where should I stay?</summary>
<div class="faq-answer"><p>Our <a href="travel.html">Travel &amp; Lodging</a> page has hotel and cabin rental recommendations. Heber is a small town, so if you know you're coming, we suggest booking your lodging soon.</p></div>
</details>

<details class="faq-item">
<summary>Is there a shuttle or a ride plan?</summary>
<div class="faq-answer"><p>There's no shuttle, we recommend renting a car. Rideshare from the venue to nearby hotels and cabins is largely unavailable, so please don't count on it. Rideshare is not available from either airport.</p><p>If you'd like to coordinate with other guests arriving or departing around the same time, send us a note at <a href="mailto:therobeywatsons@gmail.com">therobeywatsons@gmail.com</a> and we'll do our best to connect folks.</p></div>
</details>

<details class="faq-item">
<summary>Can I bring a plus-one or my kiddos?</summary>
<div class="faq-answer"><p>All ages are welcome! We know it's Mother's Day weekend and you may want to celebrate with your family. Saturday will have plenty of games and activities for every age. Your RSVP will list everyone invited. If you have any questions about your party, just reach out.</p></div>
</details>

<details class="faq-item">
<summary>When is the RSVP deadline?</summary>
<div class="faq-answer"><p>Please reply by February 14, 2027 on the <a href="rsvp.html">RSVP</a> page.</p></div>
</details>

<details class="faq-item">
<summary>Who do I ask if I have another question?</summary>
<div class="faq-answer"><p>Email us at <a href="mailto:therobeywatsons@gmail.com">therobeywatsons@gmail.com</a> or send a text to either of us.</p></div>
</details>
```
